tasks.goal: Audit the existing ui-prototype Glass/TDesign implementation against a WinUI 3-inspired web design language. Produce one Chinese QA document at output/qa/winui3-tdesign-foundation-audit.md. Cover: (1) WinUI 3 Mica / Acrylic / Solid / Smoke / Layer / Elevation semantics mapped to this repository; (2) a component coverage matrix for GlassButton, GlassInput, GlassSelect, GlassPanel, GlassDialog, GlassTable, Navigation, Feedback and Data; (3) current strengths and concrete gaps versus existing theme.css/rules/Lab; (4) a P0 reference component set and dependency order; (5) explicit non-goals and items requiring human design approval. Do not modify product code, theme.css, rules, skills, AGENTS.md, package.json, or Git history.
nonGoals: Do not modify theme tokens or Lab pages
Do not treat old proposal files as final authority when they conflict with current theme.css or AGENTS.md
